title: hopea bracteata var. perakensis
intro: Hopea bracteata var. perakensis, commonly known as Perak Hopea, is a plant species belonging to the family Dipterocarpaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and infections, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Perak Hopea are attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and combat bacterial and fungal infections. The bioactive constituents of Perak Hopea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
